title: Rejoicing in Heaven, The Marriage Supper of the Lamb, The Rider on a White Horse

questions.question: After this I heard what seemed to be the loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, crying out, "____! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,"
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:1 (ESV): "After this I heard what seemed to be the loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, crying out, 'Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,'"

questions.question: "for his judgments are true and just; for he has judged the great ____ who corrupted the earth with her immorality, and has avenged on her the blood of his servants."
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:2 (ESV): "'for his judgments are true and just; for he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality, and has avenged on her the blood of his servants.'"

questions.question: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who was seated on the throne, saying, "____. ____!"
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:4 (ESV): "And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who was seated on the throne, saying, 'Amen. Hallelujah!'"

questions.question: Let us rejoice and exult and give him the glory, for the marriage of the ____ has come, and his Bride has made herself ready;
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:7 (ESV): "Let us rejoice and exult and give him the glory, for the marriage of the Lamb has come, and his Bride has made herself ready;"

questions.question: it was granted her to clothe herself with fine ____, bright and pure"—for the fine ____ is the righteous deeds of the saints.
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:8 (ESV): "it was granted her to clothe herself with fine linen, bright and pure"—for the fine linen is the righteous deeds of the saints."

questions.question: And the angel said to me, "Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the ____." And he said to me, "These are the true words of God."
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:9 (ESV): "And the angel said to me, 'Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.' And he said to me, 'These are the true words of God.'"

questions.question: Then I fell down at his feet to worship him, but he said to me, "You must not do that! I am a fellow ____ with you and your brothers who hold to the testimony of Jesus. Worship God."
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:10 (ESV): "Then I fell down at his feet to worship him, but he said to me, 'You must not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who hold to the testimony of Jesus. Worship God.'"

questions.question: Then I saw heaven opened, and behold, a ____ horse! The one sitting on it is called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he judges and makes war.
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:11 (ESV): "Then I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse! The one sitting on it is called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he judges and makes war."

questions.question: His eyes are like a flame of fire, and on his head are many ____, and he has a name written that no one knows but himself.
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:12 (ESV): "His eyes are like a flame of fire, and on his head are many diadems, and he has a name written that no one knows but himself."

questions.question: He is clothed in a robe dipped in ____, and the name by which he is called is The Word of God.
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:13 (ESV): "He is clothed in a robe dipped in blood, and the name by which he is called is The Word of God."

questions.question: And the ____ of heaven, arrayed in fine linen, white and pure, were following him on white horses.
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:14 (ESV): "And the armies of heaven, arrayed in fine linen, white and pure, were following him on white horses."

questions.question: From his mouth comes a sharp ____ with which to strike down the nations, and he will rule them with a rod of iron.
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:15 (ESV): "From his mouth comes a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and he will rule them with a rod of iron. He will tread the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty."

questions.question: On his robe and on his thigh he has a name written, ____ of ____ and ____ of ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:16 (ESV): "On his robe and on his thigh he has a name written, King of kings and Lord of lords."

questions.question: And I saw the ____ and the kings of the earth with their armies gathered to make war against him who was sitting on the horse and against his army.
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:19 (ESV): "And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies gathered to make war against him who was sitting on the horse and against his army."

questions.question: And the beast was captured, and with it the ____ who in its presence had done the signs by which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast...
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:20 (ESV): "And the beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who in its presence had done the signs by which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped its image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur."

key_verse_text: On his robe and on his thigh he has a name written, King of kings and Lord of lords.
